hazard: Lack of family involvement in crisis care
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Emily Voukelatou
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: We have also reinforced the importance of working with families in our updated, risk assessment training which has been rolled out over the last 12 months.
promises.summary: Updated risk assessment training rolled out over the last 12 months to involve families in care pathways.

promises.quote: we have issued staff at North Camden Crisis House with clear guidance to ensure that numbers and contact details are clearly provided to families participating in a services user's care so they are able to speak directly to a senior staff member.
promises.summary: Clear guidance issued to provide families with direct contact details for senior staff.

concerns.quote: 1. I heard evidence from the consultant psychiatrist responsible for Ms [name redacted] care at Crisis House that it is not routine for the crisis team to involve family members in the care of a patient. I wonder whether that is a policy that would benefit from reconsideration? Otherwise potentially helpful input may be lost. One of the mental health nurses said that families are sometimes invited to meetings, but nobody thought about this for Ms Voukelatou. Her family live in Greece, but she was
concerns.hazard: lack of family involvement in crisis care

concerns.quote: Ms [name redacted] sister telephoned Crisis House several times, very worried, both before and after Ms [name redacted] death (not having been informed that her twin had died), but her calls were never returned. Apparently, these were not passed on to the right people, but witnesses in court were not aware of the detail of this. Leaving relatives' repeated calls unanswered cannot be right. It loses potentially valuable information, creates additional anxiety and is simply discourteous.

reports.title: Emmanuel Ladapo: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Lack of engagement with families is a story that I have heard often in inquests, and was the subject of prevention of future deaths reports that I sent to you on: 04.03.21 regarding Grazyna Walczak; and 17.03.21 regarding Ben O'Hara; and to your predecessor on: 11.01.16 regarding Efstratios Voukelatos; and 29.04.15 regarding Finnulla Martin.
the psychiatrist who saw him on each occasion omitted to ask him whether he felt suicidal

Mr Ladapo was noted to have deteriorated by the time of his consultation on 19 January 2023, and he was still depressed on 16 February 2023, but the psychiatrist who saw him on each occasion omitted to ask him whether he felt suicidal
concerns.hazard: failure to assess suicide risk during deteriorating mental state

concerns.quote: I am concerned that the importance of exploring the suicide question does not feature highly enough in the consciousness of C&I staff
concerns.hazard: insufficient focus on suicide risk assessment

links.explanation: Both reports highlight insufficient involvement of families in patients' care and communication. The earlier report focuses on not routinely inviting family to meetings and unanswered calls; the later report notes a general lack of family engagement across services.
